# gigamon_traffic_map (Resource)

Gigamon Map Schema



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monitoring_session_id` (String) Monitoring session on which this map is created
- `name` (String) Name for this map
- `rule_sets` (Attributes List) List of rule sets in this map (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule_sets))

### Optional

- `asf` (Attributes) Typed ASF configuration for AFI traffic map behavior. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--asf))
- `description` (String) Description for this map

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of this Monitoring Session for later use

<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets`

Required:

- `aep_id` (Number) the AEP endpoint ID for this ruleset. Used to connect the output of this to the tool/app using the link object
- `priority` (Number) Priority of this rule, the lower the number higher the priority
- `rule_set_id` (String) ID of this rule set, 1-5

Optional:

- `drop_rules` (Attributes List) List of drop rules for this map (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule_sets--drop_rules))
- `pass_rules` (Attributes List) List of pass rules for this map (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule_sets--pass_rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--drop_rules--erspan_id"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.drop_rules.erspan_id`

Required:

- `erspan_id_min` (Number) Lower bound (inclusive) of ERSPAN ID to match (1-1024).

Optional:

- `erspan_id_max` (Number) Upper bound (inclusive) of ERSPAN ID (1-1024). If omitted, only erspan_id_min is matched.
- `erspan_id_subset` (String) Restrict matches within [erspan_id_min, erspan_id_max] to `all` (no parity filter), only `even`, or only `odd` IDs. `even`/`odd` require erspan_id_max.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Internal rule type; auto specified, not configured by user.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--drop_rules--ether_type"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.drop_rules.ether_type`

Optional:

- `ether_type` (String) The value of the ether type byte to match
- `ether_type_end` (String) The end range of the ether type byte to match
- `ether_type_start` (String) The start range of the ether type to match
- `nested_level_count` (Number) In case of multi-VLAN tagged packet, the level at which to match the Ethertype/TPID. 0 implies any position

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) The type of the rule. Auto specified not configured by user


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--drop_rules--gre_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.drop_rules.gre_key`

Required:

- `gre_key_min` (String) Lower bound (inclusive) of GRE key to match as a 4-byte hex value (e.g. 0000000A).

Optional:

- `gre_key_max` (String) Upper bound (inclusive) of GRE key as a 4-byte hex value. If omitted, only gre_key_min is matched.
- `gre_key_subset` (String) Restrict matches within [gre_key_min, gre_key_max] to `all` (no parity filter), only `even`, or only `odd` values. `even`/`odd` require gre_key_max.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Internal rule type; auto specified, not configured by user.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--drop_rules--gtp_teid"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.drop_rules.gtp_teid`

Optional:

- `nested_level_count` (Number)
- `teid_max` (Number)
- `teid_min` (Number)
- `teid_subset` (String)

Read-Only:

- `type` (String)

### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.drop_rules.host_name`

Optional:

<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--drop_rules--ip_version"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.drop_rules.ip_version`

Required:

- `ip_version` (String) IP version to match (v4 or v6).

Optional:

- `nested_level_count` (Number) For tunneled or stacked headers, the level at which to match the IP version. 0 implies any position.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) The type of the rule. Auto specified; not configured by user.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--drop_rules--ipv4_destination"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.drop_rules.ipv4_destination`

Required:

- `address` (String) IPv4 address to match (start of range or network address).

Optional:

- `address_max` (String) Upper end of IPv4 range (inclusive). Mutually exclusive with cidr_mask and netmask.
- `cidr_mask` (String) CIDR prefix length (1-32) applied to address. Mutually exclusive with address_max and netmask.
- `nested_level_count` (Number) For tunneled/stacked IPv4 headers, which header to inspect. 0=any, 1=outer, 2=second, 3=third.
- `netmask` (String) Dotted-decimal netmask applied to address. Mutually exclusive with address_max and cidr_mask.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Internal rule type; auto specified, not configured by user.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--drop_rules--ipv4_dscp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.drop_rules.ipv4_dscp`

Required:

- `dscp` (String) DSCP code point to match (AFxx or EF).

Optional:

- `nested_level_count` (Number) For tunneled/stacked IP headers, which header's DSCP to match. 0=any, 1=outer, 2=second, 3=third.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Internal rule type; auto-specified, not configured by user.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--drop_rules--ipv4_fragmentation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.drop_rules.ipv4_fragmentation`

Required:

- `mode` (String) Which IP fragments to match.
- `unfragmented_only`: only packets that are not fragmented.
- `any_fragment`: any fragment of a fragmented packet (first and later fragments).
- `non_first_fragments`: only non-first fragments of fragmented packets.
- `first_fragment_only`: only the first fragment of fragmented packets.
- `first_or_unfragmented`: unfragmented packets or the first fragment of fragmented packets.

Optional:

- `nested_level_count` (Number) For tunneled/stacked IPv4 headers, which header's fragmentation bits to inspect. 0=any, 1=outer, 2=second, 3=third.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Internal rule type; auto specified, not configured by user.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--drop_rules--ipv4_protocol"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.drop_rules.ipv4_protocol`

Required:

- `protocol_min` (Number) Lower bound (inclusive) of IPv4 protocol number to match (0–255).

Optional:

- `nested_level_count` (Number) For tunneled/stacked IPv4 headers, which header's protocol field to inspect. 0=any, 1=outer, 2=second, 3=third.
- `protocol_max` (Number) Upper bound (inclusive) of IPv4 protocol number (0–255). If omitted, only protocol_min is matched.
- `protocol_subset` (String) Restrict matches within [protocol_min, protocol_max] to `all` (no parity filter), only `even`, or only `odd` protocol numbers. `even`/`odd` require protocol_max.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Internal rule type; auto specified, not configured by user.

### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.drop_rules.ipv4_tos`

Required:

- `tos_subset` (String) Restrict matches within [tos_min, tos_max] to `all` (no parity filter), only `even`, or only `odd` values. `even`/`odd` require tos_max.

<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--pass_rules--erspan_id"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.pass_rules.erspan_id`

Required:

- `erspan_id_min` (Number) Lower bound (inclusive) of ERSPAN ID to match (1-1024).

Optional:

- `erspan_id_max` (Number) Upper bound (inclusive) of ERSPAN ID (1-1024). If omitted, only erspan_id_min is matched.
- `erspan_id_subset` (String) Restrict matches within [erspan_id_min, erspan_id_max] to `all` (no parity filter), only `even`, or only `odd` IDs. `even`/`odd` require erspan_id_max.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Internal rule type; auto specified, not configured by user.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--pass_rules--ether_type"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.pass_rules.ether_type`

Optional:

- `ether_type` (String) The value of the ether type byte to match
- `ether_type_end` (String) The end range of the ether type byte to match
- `ether_type_start` (String) The start range of the ether type to match
- `nested_level_count` (Number) In case of multi-VLAN tagged packet, the level at which to match the Ethertype/TPID. 0 implies any position

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) The type of the rule. Auto specified not configured by user


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--pass_rules--gre_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.pass_rules.gre_key`

Required:

- `gre_key_min` (String) Lower bound (inclusive) of GRE key to match as a 4-byte hex value (e.g. 0000000A).

Optional:

- `gre_key_max` (String) Upper bound (inclusive) of GRE key as a 4-byte hex value. If omitted, only gre_key_min is matched.
- `gre_key_subset` (String) Restrict matches within [gre_key_min, gre_key_max] to `all` (no parity filter), only `even`, or only `odd` values. `even`/`odd` require gre_key_max.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Internal rule type; auto specified, not configured by user.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--pass_rules--gtp_teid"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.pass_rules.gtp_teid`

Optional:

- `nested_level_count` (Number)
- `teid_max` (Number)
- `teid_min` (Number)
- `teid_subset` (String)

Read-Only:

- `type` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--pass_rules--host_name"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.pass_rules.host_name`

Optional:

- `host_prefix` (String)

Read-Only:

- `type` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--pass_rules--ip_version"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.pass_rules.ip_version`

Required:

- `ip_version` (String) IP version to match (v4 or v6).

Optional:

- `nested_level_count` (Number) For tunneled or stacked headers, the level at which to match the IP version. 0 implies any position.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) The type of the rule. Auto specified; not configured by user.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--pass_rules--ipv4_destination"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.pass_rules.ipv4_destination`

Required:

- `address` (String) IPv4 address to match (start of range or network address).

Optional:

- `address_max` (String) Upper end of IPv4 range (inclusive). Mutually exclusive with cidr_mask and netmask.
- `cidr_mask` (String) CIDR prefix length (1-32) applied to address. Mutually exclusive with address_max and netmask.
- `nested_level_count` (Number) For tunneled/stacked IPv4 headers, which header to inspect. 0=any, 1=outer, 2=second, 3=third.
- `netmask` (String) Dotted-decimal netmask applied to address. Mutually exclusive with address_max and cidr_mask.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Internal rule type; auto specified, not configured by user.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--pass_rules--ipv4_dscp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.pass_rules.ipv4_dscp`

Required:

- `dscp` (String) DSCP code point to match (AFxx or EF).

Optional:

- `nested_level_count` (Number) For tunneled/stacked IP headers, which header's DSCP to match. 0=any, 1=outer, 2=second, 3=third.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Internal rule type; auto-specified, not configured by user.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--pass_rules--ipv4_fragmentation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.pass_rules.ipv4_fragmentation`

Required:

- `mode` (String) Which IP fragments to match.
- `unfragmented_only`: only packets that are not fragmented.
- `any_fragment`: any fragment of a fragmented packet (first and later fragments).
- `non_first_fragments`: only non-first fragments of fragmented packets.
- `first_fragment_only`: only the first fragment of fragmented packets.
- `first_or_unfragmented`: unfragmented packets or the first fragment of fragmented packets.

Optional:

- `nested_level_count` (Number) For tunneled/stacked IPv4 headers, which header's fragmentation bits to inspect. 0=any, 1=outer, 2=second, 3=third.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Internal rule type; auto specified, not configured by user.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--pass_rules--ipv4_protocol"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.pass_rules.ipv4_protocol`

Required:

- `protocol_min` (Number) Lower bound (inclusive) of IPv4 protocol number to match (0–255).

Optional:

- `nested_level_count` (Number) For tunneled/stacked IPv4 headers, which header's protocol field to inspect. 0=any, 1=outer, 2=second, 3=third.
- `protocol_max` (Number) Upper bound (inclusive) of IPv4 protocol number (0–255). If omitted, only protocol_min is matched.
- `protocol_subset` (String) Restrict matches within [protocol_min, protocol_max] to `all` (no parity filter), only `even`, or only `odd` protocol numbers. `even`/`odd` require protocol_max.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Internal rule type; auto specified, not configured by user.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--pass_rules--ipv4_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.pass_rules.ipv4_source`

Required:

- `address` (String) IPv4 address to match (start of range or network address).

Optional:

- `address_max` (String) Upper end of IPv4 range (inclusive). Mutually exclusive with cidr_mask and netmask.
- `cidr_mask` (String) CIDR prefix length (1-32) applied to address. Mutually exclusive with address_max and netmask.
- `nested_level_count` (Number) For tunneled/stacked IPv4 headers, which header to inspect. 0=any, 1=outer, 2=second, 3=third.
- `netmask` (String) Dotted-decimal netmask applied to address. Mutually exclusive with address_max and cidr_mask.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Internal rule type; auto specified, not configured by user.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--pass_rules--ipv4_tos"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.pass_rules.ipv4_tos`

Required:

- `tos_min` (String) Lower bound (inclusive) of IPv4 Type of Service to match as a 1-byte hex value (e.g. 0A).

Optional:

- `nested_level_count` (Number) For tunneled/stacked IPv4 headers, which header's TOS field to inspect. 0=any, 1=outer, 2=second, 3=third.
- `tos_max` (String) Upper bound (inclusive) of IPv4 Type of Service as a 1-byte hex value. If omitted, only tos_min is matched.
- `tos_subset` (String) Restrict matches within [tos_min, tos_max] to `all` (no parity filter), only `even`, or only `odd` values. `even`/`odd` require tos_max.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Internal rule type; auto specified, not configured by user.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets--pass_rules--ipv4_ttl"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets.pass_rules.ipv4_ttl`

Required:

- `ttl_min` (Number) Lower bound (inclusive) of IPv4 TTL to match (0-255).

Optional:

- `nested_level_count` (Number) For tunneled/stacked IPv4 headers, which header's TTL field to inspect. 0=any, 1=outer, 2=second, 3=third.
- `ttl_max` (Number) Upper bound (inclusive) of IPv4 TTL (0-255). If omitted, only ttl_min is matched.
- `ttl_subset` (String) Restrict matches within [ttl_min, ttl_max] to `all` (no parity filter), only `even`, or only `odd` values. `even`/`odd` require ttl_max.

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Internal rule type; auto specified, not configured by user.
